scope: Bound vendor disclosure acceptance and require consistent ledger report bindings
behavior: Captures the received disclosure before asynchronous validation. Checks local crypto, target network/program/address and duplicates before reading ledger.
Requires ledger presence, matching commitment/ciphertext digest and derived submission-receipt consistency before validating/installing the merged role vault.
A three-minute deadline and workspace lifetime checks follow every awaited stage. Expired or closed results cannot add the report or update the selected ledger snapshot.

reproduction.finding: Prior RoleWorkspace accepted the malformed commitment and submissionReceipt cases.
reproduction.method: Temporarily wrote git show HEAD bytes to RoleWorkspace.tsx, ran only binding cases, restored exact fixed bytes in finally.

unit.scope: Seven new acceptance cases: valid, absent, malformed commitment/digest/receipt, deadline dispatch and unmount before a delayed read. Complete RoleWorkspace and role-network regressions also pass. Crypto validation is real; handoff component and network session are mocked.

release.scope: Normal web build/typecheck and release manifest. Exact application source bytes were restored after baseline reproduction.

limits: Receipt consistency and source-provided ledger fields do not independently authenticate inclusion/finality.
Already-started crypto/SDK reads are not cancelled; the guard blocks their application continuation.
No new browser E2E, full regression, runtime refresh, native-wallet ceremony or public deployment.
